tools.name: validate_theme
tools.description: Validates a set of theme tokens against the design system's contrast contract. Valid theme ids: light, dark, high-contrast. The "high-contrast" theme requires a 7.0:1 minimum contrast ratio; "light" and "dark" require 4.5:1 for text. Non-text pairs (borders, and tone-default against their own tone-subtle fill) are additionally checked against a flat 3.0:1 floor (WCAG 1.4.11), the same across every theme including high-contrast. Omit `colors` to self-check the built-in palette for `theme`.
